data.name: Lodestone
data.description: The shaman causes one creature within 30 feet to become heavy and lethargic. The creature is treated as if it were carrying a medium load. If the creature is already carrying a medium load, it is instead treated as if it were carrying a heavy load. If the creature is carrying a heavy load, its maximum Dexterity bonus to AC is reduced to +0, it takes a -9 armor check penalty, and its movement is reduced to 5 feet. The effect lasts for %1 rounds. A successful Will saving throw (DC %2) negates this effect. Whether or not the save is successful, the creature cannot be the target of this hex again for 24 hours.|ShamanLodestoneDuration|ShamanLodestoneDC
